name: Fallen
journal: I died, and woke falling out of the sky. Men with nets were waiting.

steps.text: The bars are broken. Take Hanne's sword from where she fell and fight off the goblins.
Follow the road west to Hearthmere and find Mira at the Adventurers Guild.

name: Clear the Slimes
journal: Pip's notice: the slimes have crept out of the Slime Fields onto the north road and eat through his sacks of seed. The Guild pays for every five cleared.

steps.text: Kill slimes in the Slime Fields north-west of the village.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

place: the Slime Fields north-west of the village

name: Goblin Bounty
journal: Garrick's notice: goblins from Goblin Hollow have been robbing carts on the north road. A bounty on every three.

steps.text: Kill goblins at Goblin Hollow, north-east of the village.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

place: Goblin Hollow north-east of the village

name: Gel for the Alchemist
journal: Wren's notice: her potions need slime gel, and she has run out. Slimes drop it in the Slime Fields north-west of the village.

steps.text: Gather Slime Gel from slimes in the Slime Fields and bring it to Mira.

name: Hides for Harrow Farm
journal: Hamm's notice: winter is coming and Harrow Farm needs deer hides for coats. Deer graze the meadows round the village; they bolt, so come at them quietly.

steps.text: Hunt deer in the meadows and bring their hides to Mira.

name: Proof of the Hunt
journal: Corwin's notice: the Guild wants goblin teeth as proof that the camps at Goblin Hollow are being thinned.

steps.text: Take goblin teeth at Goblin Hollow and bring them to Mira.

name: Wolves at Greyfang
place: Greyfang Forest south-east of the valley
journal: Garrick's notice: the Greyfang pack has taken sheep from the south pastures twice this week. Thin the pack in Greyfang Forest.

steps.text: Kill wolves in Greyfang Forest, south-east of the valley.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Orc Scouts at the Outpost
journal: Corwin's notice: orc scouts from the Ironjaw Warcamp have set up an outpost past East Watch. Drive them off before more come.

steps.text: Kill orcs at the Ironjaw Outpost, north-east past East Watch.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Something Howls in Moonfell
journal: Old Bram's notice: something howls in the ruins of Moonfell at night, and a shepherd did not come home. Find it and kill it.

steps.text: Kill a werewolf in the ruins of Moonfell, south-west of the valley.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.
